project.name: Free Point
project.summary: Users sign up, receive an API key, and connect any OpenAI-compatible model to the harness API. The harness turns that model into an agent with tools exposed through MCP servers.
project.problem_statement: Project 19 - API Management and Microservices Application

course_outcomes_covered.CO2: Docker on EC2 Auto Scaling, SQS-backlog scaling
course_outcomes_covered.CO3: Custom VPC, public/private subnets, ALB, NAT instance, gateway endpoints
course_outcomes_covered.CO4: S3 (artifacts, FAISS indexes), DynamoDB (state), SQS, backup of job state via TTL and PITR
course_outcomes_covered.CO5: IAM instance profiles, KMS envelope encryption, SSM SecureString, CloudTrail, CloudWatch
course_outcomes_covered.CO6: Terraform (bootstrap + main stack), budget alarm, cost evidence, break-fix drills

model_layer.serving: llama.cpp llama-server on Colab, Qwen3-1.7B GGUF, exposed through ngrok
fallbacks: any local or hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint
model_layer.model_url_rules: https only, re-validated on every job, SSRF-guarded, stored encrypted

services.name: web
services.role: Signup (invite code), login, key issue/rotate/revoke, usage dashboard, PR approval UI

services.name: api-gateway
services.role: Public /v1 API: versioning, OpenAPI docs, API-key auth, rate limit and quota, 429 + Retry-After, idempotency keys, enqueue jobs

services.name: harness-worker
services.role: SQS consumer: agent loop, tool routing, schema validation, retries, taint tracking, audit log, writes job state

services.name: model-egress
services.role: Small no-AWS-credentials container that calls user model URLs; connect-time peer-IP validation, pinned IP with original SNI/Host, no redirects, size caps

services.name: mcp-github
services.role: FastMCP: read repo, create DRAFT PR on a branch only. Never pushes to main. Execute step runs from stored, hash-approved PR artifact

services.name: mcp-rag
services.role: FastMCP: fastembed embeddings, per-user FAISS index in S3, versioned objects with DynamoDB conditional-write pointer

services.name: mcp-gmail
services.role: FastMCP: read-only, summarize an email in 2 lines. No write scopes. Nice-to-have

services.name: mcp-rae
services.role: Static analysis of binaries and repos. Never executes anything. Parser runs in a --network none child container. First feature to drop if time runs out
services.placement: separate instance, own profile, own queue, zero KMS permission

egress.notes: source_dest_check=false, iptables MASQUERADE persisted via user_data/systemd, single point of failure (documented limitation)

security_groups.app: app port from ALB SG only; outbound 443
security_groups.rae: no inbound; outbound to SQS/S3 only

network.imds: IMDSv2 required, hop limit 2, DOCKER-USER rule drops 169.254.169.254 for containers without AWS creds (persisted)

app_asg.layout: Docker Compose on internal bridge network; only api-gateway/web exposed to ALB
app_asg.scaling: target tracking on ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible / GroupInServiceInstances (metric math)

compute.deploy: Build image -> push to ECR -> ASG instance refresh. No SSH.

tables: user_secrets (KMS envelope: GitHub/Gmail tokens, model URL and token)

data.kms: 1 CMK; encryption context user_id+tool for audit/integrity (not isolation)
data.ssm_parameter_store: SecureString for Google OAuth client secret and our own secrets
data.ecr: one repo per service image, scan on push

api.rate_limit: DynamoDB atomic counters, 429 with Retry-After and quota headers

principles: Policy lives in code, never in the prompt
All tool output is untrusted data
Approve endpoint is never reachable as a model tool
security_policy.write_policy: Every GitHub write needs human approval, single-use, expiring, bound to hash(user_id, job_id, repo, base, head, title, body, diff). Worker acks and exits at AWAITING_APPROVAL; approval enqueues an execute message that runs the stored artifact.
security_policy.taint: tainted_by_untrusted_source flag recorded in audit log (evidence), not used as the gate
security_policy.ssrf: https only, resolve and validate every IP (IPv4 and IPv6 private/loopback/link-local blocked), validate peer IP at connect time, pinned IP with original SNI/Host, redirects off, response size cap
security_policy.analyzer_sandbox: no network, read-only FS, non-root, CPU/memory/time/size limits, archive-bomb and zip-slip checks, git hooks disabled, submodules/LFS/symlinks not followed
security_policy.tenant_isolation: tenant id in every key/prefix; cross-tenant leak test required
security_policy.secrets: API keys and invite codes stored hashed; user tokens KMS-envelope-encrypted in DynamoDB; our secrets in SSM

observability.logs: structured JSON with request_id, job_id, user_id; tool-call audit log; retention 7 days

cost_guardrails: AWS Budget alarm created in P0
No interface endpoints, no managed NAT gateway
Per-job caps on steps, tokens, wall time
terraform destroy after every session (teardown is graded)
known_limitations: Shared instance role on app hosts (partly mitigated: RAE on its own instance)

evidence_plan.taint_audit_and_blocked_pr: audit log shows flag flip and AWAITING_APPROVAL
break_fixes: kill instance mid-job, SQS redelivers, no duplicate PR
tests: load test on MockLLM showing ASG scale-out

phases.name: Skeleton deploy
outputs: VPC, ALB with HTTPS, ASG, NAT instance, SQS, DynamoDB
